description_en: Lists the installation records of an Agent
description_zh: 列出 Agent 的安装记录
kebab_example: aliyun sysom list-agent-install-records --current 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id i-bp118piqcio9tiwgh84b --plugin-id 74a86327-3170-412c-8e67-da3389ec56a9 --plugin-version 3.4.0-1 --status Installed --biz-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentInstallRecords

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: current

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. If you specify this parameter, only the Agent installation records for the specified instance are returned
parameters.help_zh: 指定本字段，则过滤出指定实例的Agent安装情况
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Agent. If you specify this parameter, only the installation records for the specified Agent are returned. You can use this parameter together with the plugin_version parameter
parameters.help_zh: 指定本参数则过滤出指定Agent的安装列表，可以搭配 plugin_version 参数使用
parameters.name: plugin_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the Agent. This parameter cannot be used alone. Use this parameter together with the plugin_id parameter to filter installation records for a specific version of the specified Agent
parameters.help_zh: 不可单独使用，搭配 plugin_id 使用，用于过滤出指定Agent指定版本的安装列表
parameters.name: plugin_version

parameters.help_en: Filters component installation records by status
parameters.help_zh: 通过状态过滤组件安装记录
parameters.name: status
